notes: Desktop/wall-mount touch panel, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Manufacturer spec sheet (QSC TSC-G3 Series datasheet, comparing TSC-50-G3/TSC-70-G3/TSC-101-G3) lists only two physical I/O connectors for TSC-101-G3: 1x RJ45 (1 Gbps LAN, PoE+ Class 4 for power) and 1x USB Type-C (USB 3.1, spec sheet marks it \"for future use\"). Q-SYS Help hardware page (help.qsys.com) corroborates: RJ45 with PoE/PoE+ in, and USB Type-C supporting audio/video bridging to/from Q-LAN (USB 3.0 supported; USB 2.0 not supported by default for video bridging). No dedicated power jack — power is delivered exclusively via PoE+ over the RJ45 port. No analog audio or other connectors are present on this touch-panel device. USB 3.1 Gen 1 is electrically equivalent to USB 3.0 (5 Gbps), mapped to usb-5g grade.

ports.name: LAN (PoE+)
ports.note: Also the power input: Power over Ethernet, PoE+ Class 4

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB 3.1 Type-C; listed by QSC as "for future use" (USB video/audio bridging to/from Q-LAN per Q-SYS Help documentation)
